> ETIMEDOUT means your app sent packets to a host and port and received no reply before the clock ran out.

A refused connection proves something answered and said no. A timeout proves nothing answered at all, which is nearly always a packet-level block: a firewall dropping traffic, the wrong port, or an address that isn't reachable. Test the path with `nc -zv` before touching your code.
